svg.title: cpu efficiency
svg.desc: Computed requests per second divided by reported average CPU percent / 100. A ratio of reported averages, not energy efficiency. Each panel uses its own zero-based linear scale.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(6%,9%,12%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,41%,21%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.aria-label: RPS per 100% of reported CPU / higher is better / linear axes from zero
Highest RPS / 100% CPU: doba 130,253 in baseline / doba 749,994 in pipelined
512 connections / lite mode / 1 run per server and profile
Local measurement. Hardware and run date not supplied. One run: variability not estimated.
